architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

consumed_events.name: InsurancePolicyBound
consumed_events.purpose: Cross-capability: update customer's app to display active insurance policy and management options

design_decisions: SVC-017 receives the IPID acknowledgement and forwards to SVC-004 for processing — Channel→Capability API pattern.
SVC-004 owns InsurancePolicy (ENT-078) as the insurance intermediary system.
SVC-004 publishes EVT-167 InsurancePolicyBound consumed by SVC-001 (intra-CAP-001) for account fee update and by SVC-017 (CAP-007) for app display.
SVC-004 manages the underwriter API call (Aviva bind) as an external integration — not modelled as an internal service.

consumed_events.name: InsurancePolicyBound
consumed_events.purpose: Intra-capability: upgrade current account to Premier with insurance bundle fee; update account product type

design_decisions: SVC-001 and SVC-004 are both within CAP-001 — intra-capability event consumption for account fee update.

consumed_events.name: InsurancePolicyBound
consumed_events.purpose: Send policy confirmation and certificate of insurance to customer via email

consumed_events.name: InsurancePolicyBound
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable insurance distribution record including Consumer Duty evidence ref (FCA PROD)

cross_service_interaction_summary: SVC-017 (CAP-007) → SVC-004 (CAP-001): Channel→Capability API for product selection and IPID acknowledgement
SVC-004 (CAP-001) ↔ SVC-001 (CAP-001): Intra-capability EVT-167 consumption for account fee update
SVC-004 (CAP-001) → EVT-167 → SVC-017 (CAP-007), SVC-053 (CAP-007), SVC-103 (CAP-008): Cross-capability post-binding notifications
